show.description:
A fearless prime-time journalist sees his empire collapse overnight when a brutal media conspiracy brands him a predator and fugitive.
As AI-manipulated evidence, political power plays, and corporate greed tighten the noose, he turns to independent digital journalism to fight back. In a world where perception is power, this gripping thriller asks: when the truth is shattered, who controls the narrative?
